channel.title: GiveOwl – Christmas competitions 2026 (UK)
channel.description: UK Christmas competitions and prize draws for 2026, each linked to the organiser's own page. These are single competitions; daily-door competitions are on the advent calendar page. The purchase rule is on each entry; check the organiser's terms.

item.title: Cadbury Gifts Direct: win a 12-pack of 90g Advent Calendars – Cadbury Gifts Direct (Hemingways Marketing Services Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One 12-pack of Cadbury 90g Advent Calendars. Deadline: November 25, 2026. Enter on cadburygiftsdirect.co.uk/competition by answering: what day of the week is Day 1 of Advent in 2026? Free. Prize posted within the UK. Closes 23:59 Wed 25 Nov 2026; winner notified by email by 26 Nov

item.title: Win a family ticket for 4 to Port Lympne Illuminated – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to Port Lympne Illuminated. Deadline: November 25, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the page. UK residents 18+

item.title: Lights4fun reindeer family competition – Lights4fun Ltd
item.description: Prize: A light-up reindeer family worth £384.99. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Enter via the competition form (joins the myLights4fun email club). Free, 18+. Closes 12pm on Friday 27 November 2026

item.title: Penguin: win a White Company advent calendar with Karen Swan's The Winter Guest – Penguin Books UK (Penguin Random House)
item.description: Prize: 1 × The White Company 2026 Advent Calendar (RRP £195). Deadline: November 28, 2026. Fill in your details in the entry form on the Penguin article page by 23:59 GMT Saturday 28 November 2026. No purchase necessary. UK residents 18+, one entry per person. Winner drawn and notified on Monday 30 November 2026

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (GB) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time)

item.title: Brewers x Albany Christmas Apron Competition – Brewers Decorator Centres
item.description: Prize: 100 × Albany Christmas apron (one per winner). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Complete the online entry form on brewers.co.uk (the Instagram steps – follow @albanypaintwallpaper, like/share and tag a friend – are optional: without Instagram, email competitions@brewers.co.uk with your contact details). One entry per person, valid email required. Closes 30 November 2026, 23:59. No purchase necessary

item.title: My SZN Christmas Prize Draw: 5 × £20 gift cards – My SZN
item.description: Prize: 5 × £20 gift cards. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Create a free My SZN account and Keep or Plan a Christmas item on two different days during the promotion. UK residents, no purchase necessary. Nov 16–30, 2026

item.title: Win a family ticket for four to The Christmas Cavity Calamity Mini Panto at Penshurst Place – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to The Christmas Cavity Calamity Mini Panto at Penshurst Place. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question in the entry form on the page

item.title: Win a festive trip for a family of four to Battersea Power Station – Food and Travel Magazine
item.description: Prize: Festive trip for four worth £2,150: one night in a central London hotel plus Chimney Lift Experience, Glide ice rink and Ramses exhibition tickets. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question and fill in the form on the competition page. See full T&Cs for eligibility

item.title: Win a family ticket for four to Elf The Musical at Trinity Theatre – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to Elf The Musical at Trinity Theatre, Tunbridge Wells (Sat 12 Dec, 3.30pm). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Answer the question in the entry form on the page

item.title: Rachel Ellen Designs Christmas Giveaway 2026: win 17 festive goodies – Rachel Ellen Designs Ltd
item.description: Prize: One winner gets a bundle of 17 Christmas items (colouring and activity books, crafting and decorating sets, festive hair accessories and more). Deadline: December 7, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Christmas Giveaway page (also signs you up to the Rachel Ellen Designs newsletter; existing subscribers can enter too). One entry per person. No purchase necessary. UK residents 18+. 21 Nov – 7 Dec 2026 11:59 pm UK time; winner drawn 8 Dec

item.title: yes merino «Kiwi Xmas in the UK» giveaway: win Lamington Kiwi Christmas merino socks – JUME LTD (yes merino)
item.description: Prize: 3 winners: one family pack of four pairs of Lamington Kiwi Christmas merino socks (two adult, two baby/children) and two winners of one pair each. Deadline: December 7, 2026. Complete the giveaway form on yes-merino.com/pages/kiwi-xmas-in-the-uk-giveaway and nominate a recipient with a UK delivery address (UK residents may nominate themselves). Alternatively enter via the Facebook or Instagram giveaway post (optional). No purchase necessary. 18+. 16 November – 7 December 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: A2B Christmas Giveaway: Mystery Finds Box + 2 × £100 e-gift cards – A2B (ShopWithA2B, Byron Dittmann)
item.description: Prize: Website quiz draw: a £200 RRP Mystery Finds Box and 2 × £100 A2B e-gift cards. Deadline: December 13, 2026. Take the free Christmas quiz on the A2B giveaway page (the Instagram/Facebook draws are separate and optional). UK residents 18+, no purchase necessary. Oct 26 – Dec 13, 2026 23:59; winners contacted Dec 14

item.title: Visit Leicester Christmas Giveaway: win one of two Leicester Christmas prize packages – Visit Leicester
item.description: Prize: Two prize packages: «Family Christmas Adventure» (one-night stay for up to four at The Gresham Aparthotel, National Space Centre family annual pass, Beauty and the Beast tickets at De Montfort Hall, museum visits, chocolate workshop, afternoon tea and more) or «Leicester Staycation» (overnight stay with breakfast at The Grand Hotel Leicester, Leicester Tigers tickets, £50 Leicester Gift Card, cinema, afternoon tea and more). Deadline: December 13, 2026. Fill in the 2026 Christmas Competition form on visitleicester.info (name, email, phone, postcode, a few questions, choose your prize package). Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Closes Sunday 13 December 2026

item.title: Win an ASH Christmas Kitchen Bundle – ASH Chopping Boards
item.description: Prize: Handmade ash chopping board, oak cheese board and board butter (worth almost £100). Deadline: December 13, 2026. Enter on the page; one entry per person. UK residents, free

item.title: Brandon Hall Hotel and Spa Christmas competition: win a night for two with dinner and breakfast – Brandon Hall Hotel and Spa, Coventry
item.description: Prize: One night for two in a double room at Brandon Hall Hotel and Spa, with dinner for two in The Clarendon and full breakfast (stays from 15 January 2027, Sunday–Thursday, subject to availability). Deadline: December 14, 2026. Answer all five festive quiz questions correctly and submit your details on the competition page. Free, no purchase necessary, one entry per person. UK residents aged 18+. 17 October – 14 December 2026, 23:59

item.title: Summore Chocolate Christmas Giveaway: win a handmade Chocolate House – Summore Chocolate
item.description: Prize: One handmade Summore Chocolate House (approx. 1.8 kg Belgian milk chocolate with Christmas confetti chocolate, popping candy chocolate and Haribo, hand-painted); collection or postal delivery. Deadline: December 15, 2026. Complete the giveaway entry form on summorechocolate.com with your name and email address. Free, no purchase necessary; one entry per person. UK residents aged 18+. Closes Tuesday 15 December 2026 at 9pm (UK time); winner drawn at random and announced 16 December

item.title: SBS Hair Christmas Competition 2026: Samsung 65" 4K TV – Salon Business Solutions (SBS Hair)
item.description: Prize: 1 × Samsung 65" 4K Smart TV. Deadline: December 16, 2026. Complete the official competition entry form. Free, no purchase necessary. UK residents 18+

item.title: The Formula Christmas Giveaway 2026 – Formula Fragrances
item.description: Prize: Formula Fragrances Complete Collection (discovery box 3×10 ml + 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml). Deadline: December 17, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on formulafragrances.co.uk (one entry per person, marketing opt-in optional). UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 18 December 2026.

item.title: Wickedly Welsh Christmas Prize Draw 2026 – Wickedly Welsh Chocolate Limited
item.description: Prize: 5 × Wickedly Welsh Christmas bundle (advent calendar, bauble, Yule log, festive box; almost £50 each) or £50 credit. Deadline: December 19, 2026. Purchase required: every £10 spent on qualifying Wickedly Welsh products gives one automatic entry. 18+, mainland UK. Closes 19 December 2026; draw 21 December

item.title: B&M Pedigree & Dreamies Christmas Text to Win – Mars (Pedigree & Dreamies) at B&M
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes: 3 × £500, 1 × £150 and 1 × £100. Deadline: December 20, 2026. Purchase required: buy any Dreamies or Pedigree treat at B&M, then text XMASWIN to 81400 (standard network rate) and keep the receipt. One entry per person, GB 18+

item.title: Silverstone Christmas Giveaway 2026: karting, F1-style drive, WEC tickets and a stay at Escapade – Silverstone Circuits Limited
item.description: Prize: One winner: 2 × Kart Silverstone Adult Open Laps, 2 × Drive Silverstone Formula Single Seater experiences, 2 × General Admission tickets to the 2027 FIA WEC 6 Hours of Silverstone (23–25 April 2027), 2 × Silverstone Museum tickets and an overnight stay for two in a Residence at Escapade Silverstone with breakfast (transport not included). Deadline: December 20, 2026. Complete the Silverstone Christmas Giveaway 2026 entry form on silverstone.co.uk (first name, last name, email) or the official Meta Instant Form in Silverstone ads. Marketing opt-ins optional. Free. One entry per person. UK residents aged 18+. 17 November – 20 December 2026 11:59 GMT

item.title: Coca-Cola Christmas 2026: win Lapland and Disneyland trips (GB) – Coca-Cola Great Britain
item.description: Prize: Instant wins: 4 Lapland trips for a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 under-15s, 5 nights at Santa Claus Holiday Village), 5 VIP and 120 standard Disneyland Paris packages for 4, 3,990 Coca-Cola Christmas toy trucks and bottle e-vouchers; mop-up draw for 10 toy trucks. Deadline: December 21, 2026. In The Coca-Cola Club on the Coca-Cola App: enter pin codes from Coca-Cola packs for points (30 points per instant-win entry). No purchase necessary: call 01756 340310 (9am–5pm, standard rate) for a free code by email. Max 2 entries per day. Residents of England, Scotland and Wales 18+. Instant wins 09:00 2 Nov – 08:59 21 Dec 2026, mop-up draw to 09:00 25 Jan 2027

item.title: Racewall's 12 Days of Christmas Giveaway 2026: 12 prize draws incl. a Full Season Pass – Cowdenbeath Racewall
item.description: Prize: 12 prizes drawn every second day 2–24 December 2026: Racewall hat (2.12), hoodie (4.12), hat & hoodie (6.12), adult tickets (8.12, 10.12), family tickets (12.12, 14.12), VIP suite for a domestic meeting (16.12), family ticket to the 2026 Banger World Cup (18.12), Championship adult weekend ticket (20.12), Championship family weekend ticket (22.12) and a Full Season Pass (24.12). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Fill in the Racewall questionnaire (Google Form linked from racewall.co.uk/news/xmas2026: name, email, phone, post code and survey questions). One entry per person; the earlier you enter, the more draws you are in, and you can win more than once. No purchase necessary. UK residents aged 18+. Entries by 11am on 24 December 2026. Racewall is at Central Park, Cowdenbeath, Fife

item.title: Ferrero Rocher x Ebenezer: win a Christmas weekend getaway in London – Ferrero UK Limited
item.description: Prize: 1 × "Walk the Streets of Christmas Past" London break (3 nights in a 4* hotel with breakfast, West End show or Victorian Christmas tour tickets, Christmas afternoon tea, three-course dinner, £250 spending money and £100 travel allowance), or one of up to 20 Paramount Ebenezer merchandise packs. Deadline: December 26, 2026. Fill in the entry form on winwithferrerorocherandebenezer.co.uk (name, email, phone, postcode) – the QR code on in-store displays leads to the same form. Max one entry and one prize per person. UK residents 18+. 19 Oct – 26 Dec 2026, 23:59. No purchase necessary

item.title: Whistlefish x Celtic & Co. Christmas Competition – Whistlefish
item.description: Prize: A £250 Whistlefish voucher, a £250 Celtic & Co. voucher, a Celtic & Co. blanket and two pairs of sheepskin slippers. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the form on the Christmas competition page. Free, one entry per person. UK residents 18+

item.title: Win a Trip to New York with Arighi Bianchi x Henbury Travel – Henbury Travel Ltd in partnership with Arighi Bianchi (Macclesfield)
item.description: Prize: 3-night city break to New York for two: return economy flights from Manchester or London, 3 nights in a 4-star hotel and checked luggage (travel based on November 2027 departures). Deadline: January 30, 2027. Complete the entry form on the Arighi Bianchi competition page and say why you would love to win. One standard entry per person; no purchase necessary (orders over £500 give one extra entry). Marketing opt-in is optional. UK residents 18+. Closes 30 January 2027 at 11:59pm; winner drawn at random after closing.

item.title: PrintMedia Christmas Prize Draw 2026: win a £75 M&S gift card and Eccles cakes – SJL PrintMedia Ltd
item.description: Prize: One prize: a £75 Marks & Spencer gift card plus Eccles cakes. Deadline: December 18, 2026. Send an email to marketing@printmedialtd.com with "PrintMedia Christmas Prize Draw" in the subject line saying you would like to enter (or use the entry button in a PrintMedia email). One entry per person. UK residents 18+. Opens 6 December 2026, closes 5pm UK time on 18 December 2026. No purchase necessary
